The NBA television landscape has changed drastically recently. Beyond streaming platforms and traditional cable, over-the-air (OTA) antennas have become a powerful, free tool for watching local games in many markets. Many teams have shifted away from traditional Regional Sports Networks (RSNs) and moved their broadcasts to local, free-to-air channels. For these teams, a one-time purchase of a digital HD antenna will grant you completely free access to their local broadcasts without needing Fubo, DirecTV Stream, or any monthly subscription. Teams Available on Free OTA TV The following teams broadcast some or all of their local games on free, over-the-air channels (subject to market availability): Dallas Mavericks (KFAA 29, WFAA 8) Phoenix Suns (KTVK 3TV, KPHO-TV CBS 5, Arizona's Family Sports) Utah Jazz (KJZZ-TV 14) Chicago Bulls (Chicago Sports Network - OTA in select markets) Cleveland Cavaliers (WOIO CBS 19, WUAB MyNet 43 - select games) Indiana Pacers (WTTV CBS 4, WXIN FOX 59 - select games) LA Clippers (KTLA CW 5 - select games) Miami Heat (WSFL-TV - select games) Milwaukee Bucks (WVTV My24 - select games) Orlando Magic (WRDQ MagicTV 27, WFTV ABC 9 - select games) Can I live stream NBA Regional Sports Networks for free? Yes, you can temporarily watch your local NBA team for free by taking advantage of the free trials offered by Fubo and DirecTV Stream. Both services carry most Regional Sports Networks (RSNs), allowing you to stream in-market games without a cable subscription.
